matching_protocol.compute_and_time_budget: pre-register per run and apply consistently; record any platform-imposed limits
matching_protocol.model_and_tool_versions: pin exact provider, model, version, system prompt, retrieval corpus digest, tool configuration, and run date
matching_protocol.randomization: randomize case order and comparator order where practical; keep deterministic seeds and disclose nondeterminism
matching_protocol.repetitions: at least 3 repeated runs for nondeterministic systems; report per-run and pooled results
matching_protocol.adjudication: independent domain reviewers blinded to comparator identity where feasible

comparators.name: Manual domain-expert workflow
configuration_requirements: Record reviewer roles, credentials, jurisdictional scope, conflicts and decision authority.
Use the same frozen evidence packet and exact time budget.
Record source retrieval, discussion time, missing-evidence requests, decision reasons and dissent.
Separate individual review from final authorized decision.
comparators.interpretation_guard: Human review is not an infallible oracle; adjudicate against independent expert consensus and preserve dissent.

comparators.name: Structured checklist/template workflow
configuration_requirements: Freeze the checklist/template revision and decision rules.
Give reviewers the same inputs and evidence access.
Record required fields, validation steps, escalation paths and override policy.
Do not silently add undocumented expert review.
comparators.interpretation_guard: Do not compare a carefully staffed checklist against an unattended model without reporting resource and authority differences.

comparators.name: Single LLM
configuration_requirements: Pin provider, exact model identifier/version, inference settings and system prompt digest.
Freeze the complete prompt and tool policy.
Provide exactly the authorized evidence corpus; log retrieval omissions and tool outputs.
Run with a separately recorded compute/token/time budget.
comparators.interpretation_guard: A model output is a candidate proposal, not consent, authority, or verified evidence.

comparators.name: Retrieval-augmented LLM
configuration_requirements: Pin the base model and prompt as for the single-LLM baseline.
Freeze the retrieval corpus, embedding/index version and corpus digest.
Record top-k, filters, chunking, reranker, retrieval scores and omitted sources.
Apply the same source and time limits as all other model baselines.
required_outputs: retrieval IDs and exact source revisions
comparators.interpretation_guard: Retrieved provenance is not semantic support or authority; retrieval quality must be scored separately.

comparators.name: Multi-agent LLM
configuration_requirements: Pin all agent models, roles, prompts, routing rules, tools and orchestration version.
Record whether agents share context, evidence, memory, tools or common model/provider origins.
Define authority boundaries and prevent agent votes from becoming institutional approval.
Use the same total compute/time budget and preserve full message/event trace.
comparators.interpretation_guard: Agent count is not independent evidence; shared prompts, models, tools and inputs may create common-cause dependence.

comparators.name: IBM Engineering Requirements Management DOORS Next
configuration_requirements: Record product edition/version, modules, artifact/link types, baselines and traceability setup.
Enable and exercise supported suspect-link and change-impact workflows relevant to the same case.
Record integrations, extensions, exports, permissions and administrator configuration.
Have a DOORS Next administrator attest which requested capability was available and configured.
comparators.interpretation_guard: Do not claim DOORS Next lacks traceability, baselines, impact analysis or suspect-link workflows; compare the measured end-to-end assurance boundary.

comparators.name: Jama Connect
configuration_requirements: Record edition/version, project configuration, item and relationship types, review workflows and baselines.
Configure and exercise Trace View, Coverage Explorer, Impact Analysis and change request review where licensed and available.
Record integrations, exports, permission constraints and administrator settings.
Have a Jama administrator attest capability availability and configuration.
comparators.interpretation_guard: Do not claim Jama lacks traceability, coverage, impact analysis or review workflows; differentiate only on measured preservation of consent, evidence validity and outcome semantics.

comparators.name: Siemens Polarion ALM
configuration_requirements: Record edition/version, project configuration, work item types, links, live documents and baselines.
Configure and exercise change request impact-analysis views, traceability and audit workflows relevant to the case.
Record integrations, exports, access control and extensions.
Have a Polarion administrator attest which requested capability was available and configured.
comparators.interpretation_guard: Do not claim Polarion lacks impact analysis, traceability or audit workflows; benchmark the complete assurance requirements at equal configuration effort.

comparators.name: Mycelix Craft reference profile
configuration_requirements: Pin exact PR/commit heads and evaluator crate versions.
Use independent owner evaluators for claim support, decision closure, evidence lineage and impact qualification.
Record which layers are merged, compiled, tested, structurally checked, or still pending.
Capture exact inputs, owner receipts, independent replay outputs, false holds and reviewer effort.
required_outputs: exact revisions, digests and authority references
comparators.interpretation_guard: A synthetic fixture validator or unmerged reference crate is not an operationally qualified production system.
